brief:
A Palestinian man in Gaza has lost his family and home in an Israeli military strike, leaving him to wander the territory without shelter or relatives, Al Jazeera English reported. The man now searches for places to sleep amid the ongoing conflict that has devastated civilian communities across the enclave.

The strike exemplifies the broader humanitarian toll of the war on Gaza's population, with thousands displaced and separated from their families since fighting intensified.
dek: One man wanders Gaza in search of somewhere to sleep, having lost his family in an Israeli strike.
title: Israeli strike kills Palestinian family, leaves man homeless in Gaza
